physics-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-09.material: Ing reaksi fusi nuklir $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, massa saben partikel yaiku $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Energi sing padha karo $1\,\mathrm{u}$ dianggep $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, lan energi kinetik partikel sakdurunge reaksi diabaikan. Pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake energi $E$ sing dibebasake reaksi iki lan energi kinetik neutron yen gedhene momentum $\mathrm{^4He}$ lan neutron sing dibentuk dikira padha lan rasio massane $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.thinking.0: Hukum gerak Newton lan teori relativitas khusus
physics-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Ing reaksi fusi nuklir $\mathrm{^2H}+\mathrm{^3H}\rightarrow\mathrm{^4He}+\mathrm{n}$, massa saben partikel yaiku $\mathrm{^2H}$: $2.0141\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^3H}$: $3.0160\,\mathrm{u}$, $\mathrm{^4He}$: $4.0015\,\mathrm{u}$, neutron: $1.0086\,\mathrm{u}$. Energi sing padha karo $1\,\mathrm{u}$ dianggep $930\,\mathrm{MeV}$, lan energi kinetik partikel sakdurunge reaksi diabaikan. Pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake energi $E$ sing dibebasake reaksi iki lan energi kinetik neutron yen gedhene momentum $\mathrm{^4He}$ lan neutron sing dibentuk dikira padha lan rasio massane $4:1$?
physics-killer-09.s.s1.explain: $\Delta m=5.0301-5.0101=0.0200\,\mathrm{u}$, mula $E=\Delta mc^2=0.0200\times930=18.6\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Amarga gedhene momentum loro partikel sakwise reaksi padha, $K=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}\propto\dfrac1m$ lan $K_{He}:K_n=1:4$. Mula $K_n=\dfrac45\times18.6=14.88\approx14.9\,\mathrm{MeV}$, $K_{He}\approx3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$. Yen kuwalik sebanding massa ditulis kosok balen dadi $3.7\,\mathrm{MeV}$ (jawaban salah ②), yen energi dibagi dadi setengah dadi jawaban salah ③, lan yen $\Delta m$ salah diitung dadi $0.0400\,\mathrm{u}$ dadi jawaban salah ④.
physics-killer-09.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
